title: Special bulk regulations
previewText: The maximum floor area ratio for two or more uses on a zoning lot shall be determined by the use that is permitted the greatest floor area ratio in Area M (Map 4 in Appendix A), provided that the floor area occupied by each use does not exceed the amount permitted by the floor area ratio for that use in Area M.
